description: I was proud to nominate Karen Colón Hayes as a 2020 Massachusetts Latinx Trailblazer, and I'm so glad to see fellow Maldonian Gladys Rivera Rogers nominated by Senator Jason Lewis! Malden is so lucky to have these two incredible advocates fighting fighting for the Latinx community not only in Malden, but across the region, and across the Commonwealth
paid_for_by: Paid for by The Committee To Elect Steve Ultrino bottom of page
title: Representative Ultrino Nominates Karen Colón Hayes as 2020 Commonwealth Latinx Trailblazer
